prototype_rule: top2 active B cells per 4 TRAIN donors; top4 per single TEST donor
reference_rule: up to3 nearest same-donor same-type zero-SAE cells; no fallback, no replacement
averaging: reference equal within prototype, prototype equal within donor, donor equal within split
intervention: fixed original gene tokens/padding; replace a single binned value from reference full-cell bins; 0 when absent; no raw-count causal interpretation
comparison: same prototypes/references selected by SAE; raw coordinates are diagnostic controls, not unbiased global interpretability comparison
gene_absence: zero contribution when not tokenized; report coverage and conditional score separately
test: freeze gene rankings from TRAIN; selected high-activation prototypes, one donor; reused references are not independent samples
deletion: 0,1,5,10,20,40; own TRAIN coordinate ranking, TRAIN expression difference,10 joint-matched random sets, SAE nonribosomal ranking
random_match: original bin//10, sign(reference-original), absolute difference//5; without replacement within order; attribution genes may overlap; report overlap
